text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
choice_data_list:
W-What's gotten into you all of a 
sudden...?
W-What's with this all of a sudden...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm super exhausted from that race the 
other day!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That's why consecutive races are 
absolutely out of the question! Let meee 
reeeest~~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Btw, even if you won't let me rest, I'm 
resting anyway! Yep, decided! Resting, 
resting, resting~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her to say this much, she must be 
utterly exhausted. Perhaps I should 
reconsider her future schedule.
